title: 5 Things To Do In South Florida This Week
igCaption:
Halloween season is starting early in South Florida. 🎃
This week, South Florida, prices vary by event.

Sources: Miami New Times, Local 10, Inter Miami CF, WSVN 7News, Sun Sentinel

#Miami #SouthFlorida #Halloween #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Halloween season is already moving in South Florida, and this week has books, soccer, basketball, and costumes.
Number five: Barnes and Noble opened in Midtown Miami on October 14 at 10 a.m. The store took over the former West Elm space at 3201 North Miami Avenue, Suite 111, with 12,000 square feet.

scenes.text: Number four: the Miami Heat have their final home preseason game against the Brooklyn Nets. Erik Spoelstra plans to use it to evaluate the roster’s depth before the regular-season opener.

scenes.text: Number two: Halloween season reached Nicklaus Children’s Hospital this week. WSVN reported that young patients picked out costumes with help from Spirit Halloween of South Florida on October 14.
